name: Finley
source:
Finley, the joyful social media intern, has a lot of energy to share with everyone. Can you keep up with her and her love of Internet cats?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datenighto/hustle-cat-a-visual-novel-about-a-magical-cat-cafe]Kickstarter[/url]]

[spoiler]Finley has voice activated magic. Whenever she says an action like "block," it will cause that action to happen to the opponent. "Block" causes the opponent to be unable to move. However, her words have to be words known by the opponent as someone who does not know what "blocking" someone on the internet means would not be impacted by the word.[/spoiler]
